items.source: Builder for SpringAiAnthropicHttpClient. Mirrors the upstream com.anthropic.client.okhttp.OkHttpClient.Builder surface, with two additional optional inputs: an ObservationRegistry (defaults to ObservationRegistry.NOOP) and a MeterRegistry (optional; when supplied, OkHttp connection-pool gauges are bound to it).
items.translation: 用于构建SpringAiAnthropicHttpClient的构造器。该构造器镜像了上游com.anthropic.client.okhttp.OkHttpClient.Builder的接口，并额外提供了两个可选输入：一个ObservationRegistry（默认为ObservationRegistry.NOOP）和一个MeterRegistry（可选；当提供时，OkHttp 连接池指标将绑定到该注册表）。

items.source: Sets the executor used by the OkHttp dispatcher. When supplied, the caller owns the executor's lifecycle — SpringAiAnthropicHttpClient.close() will not shut it down. When null, an internal default is created and closed with the client.
items.translation: 设置 OkHttp 调度器使用的执行器。如果提供了执行器，调用方需负责其生命周期——SpringAiAnthropicHttpClient.close() 不会关闭它。如果为 null，则创建一个内部默认执行器，并在客户端关闭时将其关闭。

items.source: Adds an OkHttp application interceptor. The observation interceptor is outermost (added first); user interceptors are nested inside it. Consequently, on the request path user interceptors execute after the observation interceptor, and on the response path they execute before it — the observation span is open for the full duration of the user interceptor's execution. Use this to attach cross-cutting concerns such as OAuth2 bearer-token injection, custom logging, or tenant-propagation headers.
items.translation: 添加一个 OkHttp 应用拦截器。观察拦截器位于最外层（最先添加），用户拦截器嵌套在其内部。因此，在请求路径上，用户拦截器在观察拦截器之后执行；而在响应路径上，它们则在观察拦截器之前执行——观察跨度对用户拦截器的整个执行过程保持开启状态。利用此机制可附加横切关注点，例如 OAuth2 访问令牌注入、自定义日志记录或租户传播头。

items.source: Tags applied to the connection-pool gauges registered with the MeterRegistry.
items.translation: 已注册到 MeterRegistry 的连接池仪表所应用的标签。

items.source: Registers the Micrometer observation registry used by the OkHttp interceptor. Defaults to ObservationRegistry.NOOP, which makes the interceptor a no-op — no metric/span overhead in environments that don't wire observability.
items.translation: 注册由 OkHttp 拦截器使用的 Micrometer 观察注册表。 默认值为 `ObservationRegistry.NOOP`，这使得拦截器变为空操作——在未配置可观测性的环境中不会产生指标或追踪开销。

items.source: Tags applied to the connection-pool gauges registered with the MeterRegistry. Useful for distinguishing multiple clients writing pool metrics into the same registry (e.g. a sync and an async client sharing a registry). Has no effect when no meter registry is set.
items.translation: 应用于注册到 MeterRegistry 的连接池仪表的标签。可用于区分多个客户端向同一注册表写入池指标（例如，共享一个注册表的同步和异步客户端）。当未设置仪表注册表时，此参数无效。

items.source: Sets the executor used by the OkHttp dispatcher.
items.translation: 设置 OkHttp 调度器所使用的执行器。
添加一个 OkHttp 应用拦截器。

Registers a meter registry to bind OkHttp connection-pool gauges (active/idle
connections).
items.translation: 注册一个仪表注册表，以绑定 OkHttp 连接池的仪表（活动/空闲连接）。

items.source: Registers the Micrometer observation registry used by the OkHttp interceptor.
items.translation: 注册由 OkHttp 拦截器使用的 Micrometer 观测注册表。

items.source:
Registers a meter registry to bind OkHttp connection-pool gauges (active/idle
connections). Optional; when omitted, no pool gauges are registered.
items.translation: 注册一个仪表注册表，以绑定 OkHttp 连接池的仪表（活动/空闲连接）。可选；若省略，则不注册任何池仪表。
